categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Modifies HTTP RPC request error handling in src/httprpc.cpp for JSON-RPC 2.0 requests.
categories.rationale: Fixes a protocol compliance bug and an assertion failure in debug builds for malformed JSON-RPC 2.0 requests. In release builds, malformed requests return an incorrect HTTP 400 instead of HTTP 200 per spec, while in debug builds it trips an assertion check in JSONErrorReply.
